To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a robust reliability-based design approach is presented to optimize the design of base-isolation structural systems.

(i) the use of base-isolating devices in the design of buildings subjected to seismic excitations may result in a more robust design than the use of fixed-base buildings; and (ii) the robust design of base-isolators requires the consideration of multiple performance requirements and the implementation of a global optimization approach.

(1) a general framework for the robust stochastic reliability-based design of nonlinear base-isolated structural system is presented; (2) a nonlinear constrained optimization problem is formulated for the design of the system; (3) a sequential optimization approach based upon global conservative, convex and separable approximating functions is implemented to solve the optimization problem; and (4) a case study that considers a 20-story building under stochastic seismic excitation is performed to illustrate the effectiveness of the design methodology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology for the robust reliability-based design and analysis of base-isolated systems.
the robust design of structural systems with base isolation under stochastic ground excitations.
the development of an integrated design methodology to address robust design of structural systems subjected to uncertain loads and parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the stochastic design approach developed here can be applied to a wide class of structural systems and can provide a robust and reliable solution to the design problem.
the proposed methodology provides a robust framework for the design of base-isolation structural systems under uncertain future excitations.
this work provides a general framework for the robust design of structural systems that can be applied to a wide range of structural systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the robust design of base-isolators is a very complex problem.
the proposed framework provides a systematic procedure to design base-isolation systems that satisfy the required performance under a wide range of future ground motions.
the stochastic design of base-isolation structural systems is a viable approach for improving the structural reliability and reducing the structural cost.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of base isolation can significantly improve the structural performance and reliability of buildings under uncertain conditions.

robust reliability-based design optimization can be used to determine the optimal parameters of base-isolation devices in order to achieve an acceptable level of structural safety under a wide range of uncertain conditions.
the reliability of the base-isolated system is significantly higher than that of a fixed-base system.
